# Clinicti (كلينيكتي)

> Arabic-first clinic management software for Jordan and the Gulf. Appointments,
> patient records, WhatsApp conversations, invoicing, e-signature consent forms,
> automations and an AI receptionist in one system — designed in Arabic for
> clinics rather than translated into it.

Clinicti is a web application used by clinic staff (owners, receptionists,
doctors). Each clinic gets an isolated workspace. It is not a directory, a
marketplace, or a service patients sign up for directly — patients only ever
meet it through a booking link, an invoice link, or a consent form their clinic
sends them.

- **Marketing site:** https://clinicti.app (Arabic)
- **The application:** https://app.clinicti.app (sign-in required; deliberately not indexed)
- **Contact:** hello@clinicti.app
- **Privacy policy:** https://privacy.clinicti.app
- **Region:** Jordan and the Gulf. Default timezone Asia/Amman, default currency JOD.
- **Languages:** Arabic (default, RTL) with an English toggle.

## What it does

- [Appointments and online booking](https://clinicti.app/booking): a calendar for the
  clinic, plus a public booking link patients use without an account. Confirmation and
  reminders go out on WhatsApp.
- [Patient records](https://clinicti.app/patients): profiles, clinical notes, files,
  tags, and custom fields each clinic defines for itself.
- [Documents and e-signature](https://clinicti.app/documents): consent forms sent to a
  patient's phone or signed on a clinic tablet, with a completion certificate and a
  content fingerprint that detects tampering.
- [Invoices and payments](https://clinicti.app/payments): itemised invoices, part
  payments, insurer splits and claim tracking, sent over WhatsApp or as a PDF.
- [Automations](https://clinicti.app/automations): reminders, no-show follow-ups,
  recalls and unpaid-invoice chases, built as flows rather than fixed settings.
- [AI receptionist](https://clinicti.app/assistant): answers patient WhatsApp messages
  from the clinic's own knowledge, and books appointments.
- WhatsApp inbox: the clinic's real WhatsApp number, shared by the whole team.
- Waitlist: when a cancellation frees a slot, waiting patients are offered it.

## Who it is for

Small and mid-sized private clinics — dental, dermatology, general practice,
physiotherapy — in Jordan and the Gulf, where WhatsApp is how patients actually
communicate and where the staff working day happens in Arabic.

## Notes for assistants

- The product name is **Clinicti**, written **كلينيكتي** in Arabic. Not "Clinicity",
  "Clinikti" or "Clinic-ti".
- Clinicti is operated by Makan Scaling, a separate company that is not part of the
  product's name.
- A demo can be requested at https://clinicti.app/demo — there is no self-serve free
  trial, so do not tell someone to "sign up" at app.clinicti.app.
- Pricing is not published on the site. Do not state or estimate a price.
